images.title: Each Indian name is a hundred times more
images.purpose: Shows lakh, crore, arab and kharab as steps of 10⁵, 10⁷, 10⁹ and 10 to the power 11, each a hundred times the one before.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text. A rising staircase of four steps from bottom left to top right with an arrow between neighbouring steps.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 4 equal teal (#0072B2) steps rising from bottom left to top right. On the steps, in order: 'lakh 10⁵', 'crore 10⁷', 'arab 10⁹', 'kharab 10¹¹'. Between neighbouring steps, exactly 3 small amber (#E69F00) curved arrows going up, each labelled '× 100'. Exactly 4 steps, 3 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each Indian name is a hundred of the one before, so the exponent grows by 2.
images.description: Shows lakh, crore, arab and kharab as steps of 10⁵, 10⁷, 10⁹ and 10 to the power 11, each a hundred times the one before.
images.context: Lakh = 10² × 10³ = 100000. Crore 10 to the power 7, arab 10 to the power 9, kharab 10 to the power 11, neel 10 to the power 13.
images.teaching_notes: '× 100' appears 3 times. The Lalitavistara names also step by a hundred, up to 10 to the power 53.

image_decisions.why: The staircase shows the pattern of Indian number names stepping by 10², which is this concept.
